content:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — did a first pass bring-up for orion-14b int6. unit econ looks attractive but we have a small quality hit on long-context tasks.
Liam O'Neill: numbers?
Maya Chen: short summary:
```
fp16   | latency 100ms | cost/unit 1.00 | long-EM 87.2
int8   | latency 74ms  | cost/unit 0.68 | long-EM 86.1  (-1.1)
int6   | latency 62ms  | cost/unit 0.58 | long-EM 84.0  (-3.2)
```
Most regressions show up on prompts with >512 tokens and multi-step reasoning.
Noor Patel: where are these evals run? synthetic or user traffic?
Maya Chen: longform-summaries-v2 (prod-like), 2k samples; also quick smoke on sampled GTN traffic — similar pattern.
eval-bot: automated-eval run complete (1719504380) — int6 vs fp16: delta EM -3.2, p=0.008 :rotating_light:
Samir Rao: interesting. from an ops/unit-econ POV int6 would cut token cost ~42% vs fp16. that's pretty big for high-throughput features.
Priya Desai: product context — for GTN features we target >=86 EM, anything below needs product signoff. current int6 84.0 fails that.
Liam O'Neill: can we mitigate with post-processing or rerank?
Maya Chen: rerank experiment worked well — reranking top-8 from int6 with cheap scorer (distil) recovers ~1.8 EM, brings int6 to ~85.8 but adds CPU cost and latency tail.
Noor Patel: alternative: hybrid routing — short queries (<512 tokens) => int6, long queries => int8 or fp16. should capture most of the econ win while keeping long-context quality.
Samir Rao: agree. recommend routing policy and a canary with fallback to int8 when confidence low.
Priya Desai: product ask: what's the expected user-visible latency change for short queries?
Maya Chen: median latency down 25ms for the short-path; P95 unchanged for long-path if routed to int8/fp16. overall token cost reduction ~28% at 50% routed to int6.
Liam O'Neill: rollout plan suggestion:
- canary 5% traffic, observe EM for top 10 prompts + regression alerts
- 10% with rerank enabled for int6
- gradual ramp to 30% with hybrid routing
- automatic fallback: if aggregated EM drop >1.5 or p<0.01 -> rollback
Noor Patel: also add kv/prefix-cache warmstart for long-context to avoid cold-regression noise.
Maya Chen: agreed. I'll add routing policy draft and a small eval dashboard widget. tagging @product for signoff.
Priya Desai: thanks — please include estimated cost savings and the rerank CPU delta in the doc. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: will do. attaching quick perf clip and eval CSV in the internal doc (link redacted).
